maddeler.e:
تبتغون (form VIII)
# تَبْتَغُونَ (tabtaḡūna) /tab.ta.ɣuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِبْتَغَى (ibtaḡā)
# تُبْتَغَوْنَ (tubtaḡawna) /tub.ta.ɣaw.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِبْتَغَى (ibtaḡā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
